official_73_candidate_derivation.minimum_split_observation: A C4+complement raw sign-pattern model gives 70 classes, so reaching 73 from that model would require exactly three principled orbit splits, or a different topology-level equivalence definition.
official_73_candidate_derivation.no_copy_rule: No official MIT table arrays are read, transcribed, hashed, compared, or used as golden output.
official_73_candidate_derivation.verdict: No implemented no-copy model in this script derives the official 73-class mapping. The script narrows the next research question to principled splits of ambiguous high-resolution face topology and/or a different topology-level equivalence definition.

interpretation: This project's generated topology classes do not prove official Transvoxel 73-class equivalence.

If none of the topology signature counts equals 73, the current tetrahedralized transition topology is structurally different from the official 73-class table design, or the official classes depend on a richer equivalence relation not represented by these signatures.
Even if a count equaled 73, that would still be only a structural clue, not proof of matching official class IDs or triangle encodings.
